commits.subject: fix(imports): repair the four modules that inherited Mathlib from a narrowed parent
commits.summary:
**The regression.** Wave 1 narrowed 27 import-DAG sources. Four modules carried no Mathlib import of their own and were silently inheriting one, so they lost the whole library: Cohomology/StructureSheafAb (from SheafCompose), Picard/FiniteGaloisQuotient, Picard/Pic0TangentSpace and Picard/GrassmannianQuot — 124 errors, caught by the verification build before anything was claimed green.

**The repair.** Three now carry their own precise imports (StructureSheafAb 5, Pic0TangentSpace 6, FiniteGaloisQuotient 3). GrassmannianQuot resisted: with narrowed imports it times out at `isDefEq` (:924) and `whnf` (:1217) at the default 200,000 heartbeats, so `deumbrella.sh` restored its umbrella automatically. Narrowing is therefore NOT always free — a smaller environment can send a defeq check down a different, slower path — and that is exactly why every conversion re-elaborates the file and reverts on failure.

**Process fix.** A source must be converted together with its dependents that import no Mathlib of their own, and every wave must end with a full build before the next begins — which is what `scripts/deumbrella-wave.sh` does and what running wave 1 as a raw parallel loop skipped.
